name: aws-data-pipeline
title: Data pipeline
summary: Takes records that linked apps send, optionally reshapes them with a linked Lambda function, and stores them as JSON in a linked bucket, by day. A Glue table and an Athena workgroup make them queryable with SQL, with no crawler to run.
checks: Stores what it receives in its linked bucket every {buffer_seconds} seconds or {buffer_mb} MB, compressed, by day
Records are encrypted in transit and at rest
One Athena query may scan at most {scan_limit_gb} GB
Apps linked to it may only send records to it; the data stays in the bucket, which removal keeps

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The fields of each JSON record and their types, for the Athena table: string, bigint, double, boolean or timestamp.

scan_limit_gb.title: Most data one query may scan (GB)
